DuplicateCase.Title: Verify Safe State of Gripper During Obstacle Avoidance
DuplicateCase.Description: Test that the gripper remains in a safe state (either open or closed) when an obstacle is detected during movement, based on current task status.
DuplicateCase.Objective: Validate gripper behavior under dynamic environmental conditions
DuplicateCase.Comments: Ensure no unintended gripper action occurs during collision avoidance

MatchedWith.Title: Verify Collision Avoidance with Obstacle Detection During Movement
MatchedWith.Description: Validate that the robot detects an obstacle in its path using sensors and halts or reroutes to avoid collision, ensuring compliance with RQ1–RQ5. The gripper must remain in a safe state (open or closed) depending on current task status.
MatchedWith.Objective: Ensure robust collision avoidance mechanism during dynamic movement
MatchedWith.Comments: Test includes verification of sensor data processing and robot response
